title: Assoc. Specialists/Intercompany Arrangements Office
description:
**About Northern Trust:**


Northern Trust, a Fortune 500 company, is a globally recognized, award\-winning financial institution that has been in continuous operation since 1889\.


Northern Trust is proud to provide innovative financial services and guidance to the world’s most successful individuals, families, and institutions by remaining true to our enduring principles of service, expertise, and integrity. With more than 130 years of financial experience and over 22,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

**Job Summary:**  

The Intercompany Arrangements (ICA) Associate Specialist is a key position within Northern Trust’s Service Level Governance and Reporting function. As an ICA Associate Specialist you need to ensure effective oversight, governance, and risk management in accordance with Northern Trust’s standards and regulatory requirements.

 **Major Duties**

* **Risk Assessment \& Quality Checks:** Oversee timely completion of risk assessments such as IRQ, DDQ and perform end to end quality check of the relationship across its lifecycle including IRQs and DDQs. Select risk\-based samples for review and ensure logical, consistent responses. Log deficiencies, engage with the stakeholders for remediation and escalate unresolved issues.

* **Contracting \& Inventory Management:** Verify proper storage and recording of ICSAs; ensure Service Descriptions are complete and meet required standards.

* **Monitoring \& Reporting:** Conduct lifecycle monitoring of ICAs through KPIs/KRIs, Incident trigger events, Open Issues from 2LoD/3LoD or regulators. Also, ensure to log and report exceptions and breaches appropriately, and engage with stakeholders for taking necessary actions on the exceptions, escalate as required.

* **Program Review \& Data Reconciliation:** Perform annual and semi\-annual reviews of registers, lists, and inventories. Reconcile databases and ensure all documentation is up to date.

* **Lead Projects:** Identityand Lead projects to optimize the processes, enhance the system user experiences in Coupa, integration with other systems such as Service Now, feed key information for Virtual data center, etc.

* **Management** **Reporting/Dashboards:** Assist the team in preparing executive slides for management meeting and reporting, including providing overall status of the ICA Standard, highlight key issues, themes, challenges, ongoing projects etc.

 **Experience and Qualifications**  

**Experience:** 8\+ Years of experience, post\-graduation degree such as CA/MBA is preferred

* Strong understanding of and experience in risk management, governance, control and compliance preferred. Working experience in Third Party Risk Management will be an added advantage.
* Excellent analytical skills for and the ability to reviewing questionnaires, assessments, and reports.
* Attention to detail for documentation and logging.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and proven ability to effectively interact with stakeholders.
* Familiarity with systems and tools such as Coupa CRA and SharePoint.
* Ability to accurately identify, escalate, and drive actions to mitigate priority risks
* Strong organization, attention to detail, time management, planning skills and the ability to handle multiple competing priorities
* Ability to develop strong relationships and build stakeholder alignment on key initiatives

**Eligibility for Internal Partners**

* 3 years as a Team Leader to move as a Section Manager currently at an Officer level.
* 24 months as a Consultant to move as a Senior Consultant. Movement within Senior Consultant and Section Manager is applicable if they have prior 36 months of people management experience.

**Working with Us:**


As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability is an asset that emboldens us to explore new ideas.


Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to assisting the communities we serve! Join a workplace with a greater purpose.


We’d love to learn more about how your interests and experience could be a fit with one of the world’s most admired and sustainable companies! Build your career with us and apply today. \#MadeForGreater

**Reasonable accommodation**


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com.


We hope you’re excited about the role and the opportunity to work with us. We value an inclusive workplace and understand flexibility means different things to different people.


Apply today and talk to us about your flexible working requirements and together we can achieve greater.

**About Our Pune Office**


The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.


Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Head - Health Management
description:
**Role Purpose**


The Head of Health Management will provide **strategic medical and health leadership** across the organization, ensuring that employee health, occupational medicine, wellness, and emergency medical preparedness are fully integrated into the company’s EHS governance and Zero Harm culture.


This role requires a senior medical professional with **deep industry exposure**, capable of transitioning medical expertise into organizational strategy, governance, and leadership influence at corporate and site levels.

**Experience \& Qualification Requirements**

**Essential Qualifications**

* **MBBS** with **Post‑Graduate qualification** in one or more of the following:
* + Occupational Health / Industrial Medicine
	+ Community Medicine / Preventive \& Social Medicine
	+ Public Health (MPH)
* Valid medical registration with relevant medical council.
* Associate fellow in industrial hygiene.
* Additional certifications in **Occupational Health, emergency medicine, or health systems** will be an advantage.

**Experience Profile**

* **20\-25 years of total professional experience**, with:
* + At least **12–15 years in Engineering, Energy, Infrastructure, EPC, manufacturing, or heavy Industry**
	+ Minimum **8\-10 years in a corporate / regional leadership role as Head of Health Management / Corporate Medical Head**
* Proven experience supporting:
* + Multiple factories, project sites, and offices
	+ Contract workforce health management
	+ Leadership interactions with Business Heads, CEO/ MD

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Strategic Health Management Leadership**

* Define and implement the **Corporate Health Management Strategy** aligned with EHS objectives, legal requirements, and business priorities.
* Establish health as a **core enabler of Zero Harm and business continuity**, not merely a compliance function.
* Translate medical strategy into scalable programs across factories, project sites, and offices.

**2\. Occupational \& Preventive Health Governance**

* Lead programs for:
* + Occupational disease prevention
	+ Health surveillance and medical examinations
	+ Fitness‑for‑work and return‑to‑work protocols
* Ensure compliance with:
* + Factories Act (India) and applicable local laws
	+ Global EHS / Occupational Health standards
* Own medical governance related to contractors and high‑risk work environments.

**3\. Emergency Medical Preparedness \& Crisis Support**

* Define medical emergency preparedness frameworks as part of:
* + Emergency Response Teams (ERT)
	+ Crisis Management Teams (CMT)
* Guide:
* + Medical response protocols
	+ Selection and audit of external medical facilities
	+ Pandemic, outbreak, and mass‑casualty preparedness
* Provide medical leadership during **major incidents and crises**, in coordination with EHS, Security, P\&O (HR), and Leadership.

**4\. Workplace Wellness \& Psychosocial Health**

* Lead holistic health programs covering:
* + Physical health
	+ Mental health and psychosocial well‑being
	+ Fatigue management and lifestyle risks
* Partner with P\&O (HR) and leadership to build:
* + Manager sensitization programs
	+ Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs)
	+ Well‑being metrics linked to engagement and productivity

**5\. Medical Infrastructure \& Vendor Governance**

* Establish standards for:
* + Occupational health centers
	+ Medical rooms at sites and offices

title: HR Generalist (Startup Operations & AI GRC Focus)
description:
**About the Company**



Verterim is a Governance, Risk and Compliance company focused on helping organizations build, promote and mature their GRC programs. We take a business process view of GRC, with a focus on rapid development based on experience yielding quick time to value for our clients. We are driven by highly skilled, qualified employees combined with practiced industry expertise, matching the technical skills to manage the platform with the business skills needed to develop and implement client\-specific use cases.

 **Role Overview**

  


As our HR Generalist, you will be the backbone of our people operations. You will manage everything from the pulse of the office to our international recruitment efforts. This role requires a "builder" mindset—someone who can execute today’s payroll while drafting tomorrow’s scaling policies.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  

* HR Business Partnering (BP) \& Strategy

	+ Act as a point of contact for department leads across domestic and US operations to align HR initiatives with business goals.

	+ Use data\-driven insights to provide recommendations on team structure, performance management, and international workforce planning.

	+ Drive the annual and quarterly performance review cycles for both geographies.
* US Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

	+ Lead the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for our both domestic and US\-based roles (Sales, Solutions Architects, and GRC Consultants).

	+ Manage sourcing, initial screening, and interview coordination across different time zones (IST and US time zones).

	+ Build a talent pipeline within the AI and GRC space.

	+ Partner with hiring managers to tailor recruitment strategies to each region and role's talent landscape.
* Payroll \& Benefits Administration

	+ Own the monthly payroll processing for domestic and international (US\-based) employees.

	+ Manage statutory compliance for India (PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, Gratuity) and the US (federal/state tax filings, FICA, unemployment insurance).

	+ Administer benefits programs across both regions, including Health Insurance, 401(k) for US employees, and PF/group health for India employees.

	+ Manage classification and compliance for both w2 employees and 1099 contractors in the US, and full\-time employees and consultants in India.

	+ Act as the primary contact for all payroll\-related queries from employees in both countries.
* Policies \& Compliance

	+ Design, implement, and update HR policies that reflect a modern, flexible AI startup culture while accommodating regional requirements.

	+ Ensure all policies are compliant with local labor laws (Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Maternity Benefit, etc.) and US federal and state employment laws (FLSA, FMLA, ADA, EEO, state\-specific requirements).

	+ Draft and maintain the region\-specific Employee Handbooks for India and US teams.

	+ Stay current on regulatory changes in both jurisdictions and proactively update policies.
* Employee Relations \& Wellbeing

	+ Serve as a trusted advisor for employees in both countries, managing conflict resolution and grievance redressal with cultural sensitivity.

	+ Design and execute "Employee Wellbeing" programs tailored to a remote/hybrid workforce spanning multiple time zones.

	+ Organize virtual and in\-person team\-building activities and culture\-driven initiatives to maintain high morale in distributed teams.
* Day\-to\-Day Operations

	+ Manage the seamless onboarding of new hires and offboarding of departing team members across both entities, including region\-specific documentation.

	+ Maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS for both populations.

	+ Handle general office administration and vendor management for HR tools serving both regions.

  


**Qualifications \& Skills**

  


* Experience: 3\+ years in an HR role, preferably within a tech startup or SaaS environment.
* Global Exposure: Proven experience in US Recruitment and familiarity with US labor laws/payroll (1099 vs. W2\) is highly preferred and Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, POSH).
* Tech Savvy: Proficiency with HRIS platforms (e.g., BambooHR, GreytHR). Experience with US payroll providers is a plus.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to handle sensitive information with total discretion across cultural contexts.
* Mindset: A "no task is too small" attitude and the ability to pivot quickly as company priorities evolve. Comfort working flexible hours to support employees across IST and US time zones.

  


**Why Join Verterim?**

  

* Opportunity to shape the culture of a company tackling the biggest challenge in tech: AI Governance
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Full time remote working culture
* Flexible working hours and a high degree of autonomy
* Health and wellness stipends

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**kAIgentic** is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know\-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI\-powered operations.


The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.


We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1\.

### **The Role**


As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will work directly with the CHRO, the Head of Talent Acquisition, and the core leadership team to build the people foundation that lets kAIgentic’s intelligence layer scale. You will solve the hardest problems in building a high\-performance, AI\-native culture, designing people systems that use AI natively, and standing up the early\-career talent engine that powers our next phase of growth.


This is a role for a hands\-on, systems\-thinking HR professional who wants to do more than run processes. You will translate our values of customer obsession, courage, care, and curiosity into how the company actually operates, and you will partner with our tech team to shape AI\-first people systems where the work is real and directly tied to how kAIgentic grows.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Build and scale a high\-performance, AI\-native culture rooted in our values of customer obsession, courage, care, and curiosity, and launch programs that bring those values to life every day.
* Translate mission and principles into daily operating norms: decision rights, feedback mechanisms, and leadership behaviors that match our growth phase.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to design and embed AI\-native HR workflows, including performance review, listening mechanisms, AI\-assisted policy Q\&A, and people analytics summaries, into how HR operates.
* Design lightweight performance and feedback rhythms suited to a high\-bar, low\-politics, early\-stage environment.
* Lay the analytics foundation. Implement HRIS, build simple dashboards, and ensure clean, reliable people data.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to sharpen our employer brand and Employee Value Proposition, build a champion community of employees who tell our story externally, and collaborate on content and social campaigns.
* Build the end\-to\-end early\-career talent engine: target institutions, role design, internships, fellowships, live projects, and case challenges, with structured 0\-to\-1 learning paths so freshers contribute to real work from week one.
* Own the lifecycle moments that shape employee experience: onboarding, manager connects, performance reviews, career conversations, and exits.
* Drive the annual performance review cycle for India leaders across Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.
* Build engagement mechanisms such as pulse checks, team connects, and recognition forums, and translate employee signal into practical actions with managers and leaders.
* Partner with managers to spot early signs of friction, disengagement, or manager\-effectiveness gaps, and resolve them with speed and maturity.
* Manage grievances with fairness, confidentiality, and judgment. Stand up the Grievance Committee and POSH foundation.
* Work with external partners (search firms, legal, payroll / PEO, advisors) to continuously improve the experience of core HR operations.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* 7\+ years of experience in HR, with a strong mix of Talent Acquisition and HR business partnering or people operations.
* AI\-native velocity as a default mode of working (mandatory). Curious about how AI\-native workflows can make HR sharper, faster, and fairer, and willing to learn by doing.
* Proven experience partnering with Product and Engineering leaders and driving engagement of senior tech talent in product / SaaS, fintech, consulting, or high\-growth tech startups where the bar for talent and pace is high.
* Hands\-on experience setting up or significantly improving HR processes, policies, and tools in a lean environment.
* High ownership bias. You see gaps, propose solutions, and run them to the ground.
* Comfort working directly with founders and senior leaders, including pushing back thoughtfully using data and judgment.
* Energized by complex domains even when you are not yet an expert, with a track record of learning quickly.
* Sound judgment, discretion, and fairness in handling sensitive employee matters.

**Why join kAIgentic?**


We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.


We look for people who:

* Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.
* Are entrepreneurial and energized by zero\-to\-one problems with no playbook.
* Lead with ownership, integrity, and collaboration, not titles.
* Want to help define a new category of enterprise AI, not just ship inside an existing one.
* Working here means being surrounded by peers who challenge assumptions, celebrate progress, and build with both courage and care.

**Life at kAIgentic**

* Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production\-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.
* Innovation at enterprise scale. Startup velocity meets the depth, scale, and stakes of mission\-critical, regulated environments. Both are non\-negotiable.
* Ownership from Day One. Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the outcomes our customers see.
* Learning and growth. You will work alongside seasoned leaders from leading enterprises who have built and scaled global businesses.
* A culture of trust. Psychological safety, transparent disagreement, and disciplined experimentation are how we operate, not slogans on a wall.
* Global collaboration. Teams across Singapore, India, Japan, Europe, and the US, working as one.
* A mission worth the effort. Building something the world has not seen before: anintelligence layer that helps enterprises continuously improve how they run.

Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. * Lead the conceptualization and high\-level design of innovative, AI\-driven solutions, focusing on significant business value, user experience, safety and compliance.

title: HR Tech Data Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?** **Purpose of the Role :**  



This is a rare and distinctive role at the intersection of People, Technology, and AI.



You will own Keyloop’s People Technology ecosystem and HR data infrastructure, including rebuilding a Python\-based analytics platform connected to our data lake and core HR systems. This platform will deliver secure, SSO\-enabled insights and power reporting across People Analytics, Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Engagement. You will also lead integrations with systems such as SAP SuccessFactors.



Alongside this, you will act as an internal expert in agentic AI. You will enable teams to confidently use AI and data, combining hands\-on building with strong teaching and influencing.



Operating with high autonomy, you will partner with senior leadership to shape both **w**hat we build and how AI is adopted globally.



### **Role \& Resonsibilities**


* Own and evolve Keyloop’s People Data Platform and HR analytics dashboard (Python/Streamlit), delivering insights via SSO
* Design and maintain data architecture (pipelines, schemas, models) across SAP SuccessFactors and other HR systems
* Manage API integrations and data access with core platforms and third\-party vendors
* Deliver insights across People Metrics, TA, L\&D, and Engagement, partnering with functional leads
* Own BAU reporting, driving accuracy, automation, and self\-service adoption
* Ensure GDPR and data compliance, including access controls and auditability
* Build and scale AI\-driven HR solutions (LLMs, agentic workflows, document processing, large\-scale pipelines)
* Develop production\-ready AI use cases (e.g., attrition insights, skills inference, policy Q\&A, candidate processing) and evaluate emerging tools
* .Act as HR AI SME, enabling adoption through training, playbooks, and self\-service frameworks across HR and G\&A
* .Partner with senior leadership, IT (AWS), and governance forums to shape the People Technology roadmap and responsible AI practices
### **Skills \& Experience**

### **Essential**


* Strong Python expertise building production\-grade data applications, dashboards, or tools.
* Hands\-on experience in data engineering (ETL pipelines, API integrations, data modelling).
* Proven track record integrating LLM/AI APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) into live applications.
* Solid knowledge of AWS and modern data/visualisation frameworks (e.g., Streamlit, Plotly).
* Experience with SSO/authentication (OAuth2, SAML, Azure AD / Entra ID).
* Strong data literacy and storytelling, with the ability to communicate insights to non\-technical audiences.
* High autonomy with a rigorous approach to data privacy, security, and compliance.

### **Desirable**


* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or similar HRIS, including API/OData integration.
* Proficiency in Power BI (data modelling, DAX, dashboards).
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI).
* Experience designing or delivering learning/upskilling programmes.
* Understanding of HR data domains (e.g., headcount, attrition, hiring, engagement).
* Exposure to Azure ecosystem and/or Terraform.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders, vendors, and global teams.
**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Job Title: Embedded R\&D Engineer**

**Department: Engineering Location:** ***OLD JAGATPUR, CUTTACK, ODISHA***

**Experience Required: Basic fundamental knowledge on embedded engineering/*****Min 6 months working as embedded engineer intern/ Working in startup will be given preference***

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a skilled and self\-motivated Embedded Developer Intern with hands\-on knowledge in bare\-metal programming for **microcontrollers and microprocessors.** The ideal candidate will excel at reading datasheets, writing efficient, clean, and custom code without relying on external libraries or AI\-based assistance, and working independently to design and implement robust embedded solutions.

The candidate should demonstrate expertise in low\-level **hardware\-software integration,** serial and wireless communication protocols, and a solid understanding of embedded platforms such as **AVR, STM32,** or similar architectures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Firmware Development:**

o Develop, test, and debug firmware for embedded systems, primarily for **AVR, STM32, or similar platforms.**

o Implement optimized, lightweight code for bare\-metal applications.

o Integrate hardware peripherals **(GPIO, ADC, UART, SPI, I2C, etc.)** with custom firmware.

**2\. Hardware Interaction:**

o Analyze and interpret datasheets, reference manuals, and schematics to enable seamless hardware\-software integration.

o Collaborate with the hardware team to design and validate **embedded hardware interfaces.**

**3\. Protocol Implementation:**

o Design and implement communication protocols, including UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN.

o Develop wireless communication solutions using LoRa, Bluetooth, ZigBee, or equivalent technologies.

**4\. Testing \& Debugging:**

o Perform hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing to validate embedded designs.

o Use debugging tools such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and protocol analyzers.

**5\. Documentation \& Collaboration:**

o Maintain comprehensive documentation of firmware designs, processes, and debugging steps.

o Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure project timelines and deliverables are met.

\-\-\-

Required Skills and Qualifications:

**· Technical Proficiency:**

o Strong proficiency in C, C\+\+, and low\-level assembly programming.

o Experience with bare\-metal development and RTOS is highly desirable.

o Familiarity with microcontrollers like AVR, STM32, or SoCs with ARM Cortex cores.

**· Peripheral Knowledge:**

o Deep understanding of hardware peripherals such as ADC, PWM, Timers, and DMA.

o Knowledge of interfacing sensors, displays, and actuators with embedded platforms.

· Communication Protocols:

o Proficient in serial communication protocols **(UART, I2C, SPI, etc.).**

o Experience in wireless protocols like **LoRa, Bluetooth, or ZigBee.**

**· Debugging \& Tools:**

o Hands\-on experience with debugging tools such as **JTAG, SWD, and software like Keil, IAR, or STM32CubeIDE.**

o Proficiency in using lab equipment: logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and multimeters.

· Soft Skills:

o Strong problem\-solving ability and a proactive approach to debugging and optimization.

o Ability to work independently and deliver high\-quality, scalable solutions with minimal supervision.

\-\-\-

**Preferred Qualifications:**

· Knowledge of low\-power design principles for **embedded systems.**

· Familiarity with SoCs or microprocessors **(e.g., ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or ARM Cortex).**

· Understanding of bootloaders, firmware\-over\-the\-air (FOTA) updates, and secure firmware practices.

.Knowledge in version control systems like Git.

· Exposure to automotive or industrial\-grade embedded systems (optional but a plus).

description:
**Role: Content Creator** 

**Experience:** 0 \- 1\.5 years

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Role Overview

We’re looking for a creative, witty, and chronically online Content Creator to join the team. You’ll be the brain behind the scroll\-stopping content, the one who knows when a trending Reel audio is peaking, when it’s already over, and which client tone it actually fits.

Key Responsibilities

* **Content creation:** Plan, write, shoot, and edit content across Instagram (feed \+ Stories \+ Reels), Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, and Pinterest.
* **Creative ideation:** Bring witty, on\-trend ideas to the table for client/in\-house projects across niches.
* **Original thinking:** Generate fresh, brand\-specific ideas rooted in each project’s niche, audience, and tone. Content that feels native to the brand's world, not recycled or one\-size\-fits\-all.
* **Platform strategy:** Build platform\-specific content plans tailored to each project’s niche, audience, and goals.
* **Shoot \& edit:** Shoot basic photos and videos in\-store, on\-location, or in\-studio when required. Edit short\-form video for Reels, Shorts, and Stories.
* **Community management:** Engage with comments, DMs, and audience interactions across platforms.
* **Trend tracking:** Stay on top of platform updates, trending formats, audios, and meme cycles.
* **Performance reporting:** Track key metrics (reach, engagement, saves, follower growth) and report on what’s working.
* **Ads support:** Collaborate with the ads team on Meta Ads and Google Ads, creative inputs, copy, basic setup, and performance review.
* **Influencer marketing:** Research, shortlist, and outreach to relevant influencers and creators for client campaigns, manage briefs, deliverables, timelines, and post\-campaign reporting.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* 0 \- 1\.5 years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing. Strong fresher portfolios are welcome.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, and Pinterest, not just as a user, but as a creator/manager.
* A creative streak, sharp wit, and a sense of humor that translates to a screen.
* Comfortable on both sides of the camera, happy to shoot, and happy to be shot.
* Basic photo and video editing skills (Reels, Stories, Shorts) using VN Editor, InShot, or similar.
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, enough to set up basic campaigns, read performance, and contribute creatively.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Comfortable coordinating with internal teams, clients, and external collaborators (e.g., influencers, vendors).
* Ability to juggle multiple client accounts and switch tone of voice depending on the brand.
* An eye for what works on each platform, Pinterest is not Instagram, it is not LinkedIn.
* Organized, deadline\-aware, and able to take ownership without constant follow\-ups.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Liaison Executive (Legal \& Compliance) Role Overview The Liaison Executive will serve as the primary interface between the organisation and government authorities, regulatory bodies, and statutory departments. This role demands a working knowledge of law, regulatory frameworks, and compliance procedures, making it well\-suited for an LLB graduate with an understanding of administrative and corporate law. Position Details Department: Legal \& Compliance / Administration Qualification: LLB (Bachelor of Laws) – Mandatory Experience: 0–2 years (Freshers with internship experience welcome) Employment Type: Full\-Time Key Responsibilities Government Liaison \& Regulatory Interface **Coordinate and maintain structured communication with government departments, regulatory bodies, and statutory authorities.**  Represent the organisation in person at government offices for submission, follow\-up, and retrieval of documents, permits, and approvals. **Monitor and track pending applications, licences, registrations, renewals, and NOCs with the relevant authorities. Legal Documentation \& Statutory Compliance**  Draft, review, and organise legal correspondence including letters, applications, affidavits, declarations, and notices for submission to government authorities. **Ensure all documents submitted to regulatory bodies are accurate, complete, and compliant with applicable statutes and procedural requirements.**  Assist in managing compliance calendars for statutory filings, renewals, and regulatory deadlines. **Maintain proper records of all legal documents, approvals, and official correspondence in a structured filing system.**  Ensure confidentiality and integrity of sensitive legal and organisational records at all times. Internal Coordination \& Reporting **Liaise with internal departments (HR, Finance, Operations) to collect requisite documents and information for regulatory submissions.**  Prepare concise status reports on ongoing liaisoning activities, approvals in pipeline, and compliance status for management review. **Support management in handling administrative tasks related to legal and regulatory affairs. Required Skills \& Competencies**  Sound understanding of Indian regulatory frameworks, government procedures, and administrative law. **Ability to draft precise legal correspondence, applications, and compliance documents.**  Strong interpersonal and professional communication skills for dealing with government officials. **Meticulous attention to detail in document review and record management.**  Ability to work independently, manage field visits, and meet regulatory deadlines. **Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and email communication.**  Analytical and problem\-solving orientation with a compliance\-first mindset. Qualifications **LLB (Bachelor of Laws) from a recognised university – Mandatory.**  Knowledge of corporate law, administrative law, or regulatory compliance is an advantage. **Prior internship or work experience in liaisoning, legal compliance, or government affairs is preferred.**  Proficiency in the regional language (as applicable) alongside English and Hindi will be an added advantage. description:
**Derivatives \& Options Trader**

*HFT Trading Desk — Hyderabad, India (On\-site)*

**Location**

Hyderabad, India — On\-site, Full\-time

**Experience**

1–3 years \| Exceptional freshers welcome

**Compensation**

₹50,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month (based on skill demonstration)

**Apply to**

hr@stringmetaverse.com

**ABOUT STRING METAVERSE**

String Metaverse Limited (BSE: STRING) is a publicly listed company operating at the intersection of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and high\-frequency trading. Our Dubai\-headquartered trading desk runs autonomous options strategies on crypto and equity derivatives, with our technology stack spanning Deribit, Tastytrade, Hyperliquid, and Solana\-native DeFi protocols. We are building AI agents that trade, reason, and evolve — and we want traders who think the same way.

**THE ROLE**

You will be a core member of our HFT \& Digital Advisory desk, working directly on live derivatives positions, trade reporting, and strategy research. This is not a back\-office role — you will be expected to understand live positions, propose strategic improvements, and use AI tools to move faster and think more clearly than a traditional analyst ever could.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

– Monitor and manage live options positions — diagonal spreads, theta strategies, and volatility plays on BTC, ETH, and US equities

– Read, interpret, and act on trade reports — P\&L attribution, Greeks exposure, and drawdown analysis

– Research and back\-test options strategies; identify entry and exit signals using data\-driven frameworks

– Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and trade logs using AI tools including Claude, Claude Code, and Cursor

– Collaborate with our AI Agents team to feed market insights into autonomous trading agents

– Support on\-chain and off\-chain trade reconciliation across Deribit, Tastytrade, and Hyperliquid

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

*We evaluate how you think, not what your CV looks like. Inspired by how the world's best trading firms hire, we care about problem\-solving, mathematical intuition, and intellectual curiosity above credentials.*

– **Mathematical intuition —** Fast, accurate reasoning about probability, expected value, and risk — you think in distributions, not just averages

– **Options literacy —** Solid understanding of options payoffs, Greeks (delta, theta, gamma, vega), and how they interact across time and volatility regimes

– **Analytical depth —** Ability to read a trade report, spot anomalies, and frame a clear data\-backed view of what to do next

– **AI fluency —** You actively use Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent AI tools in your daily workflow; bonus if you have used Claude Code, Cursor, or built prompts to automate analytical tasks

– **Communication —** Ability to explain a complex position or risk scenario concisely, in writing or verbally

– **Edge\-case thinking —** You naturally ask "what could go wrong?" before asking "what is the expected return?"

**GOOD TO HAVE**

– Exposure to crypto derivatives (Deribit, Bybit, Hyperliquid) or US equity options (Tastytrade, IBKR)

– Familiarity with Python, Excel modelling, or any scripting for data analysis

– Academic background in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or Economics

– Understanding of blockchain, DeFi, or on\-chain trading mechanics

– Experience with back\-testing frameworks or systematic strategy research

**OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY**

We do not enforce GPA cutoffs or require a finance degree. A fresher who thinks sharply, uses AI tools effectively, and reasons well under uncertainty will be preferred over an experienced candidate who works on instinct alone. Compensation is determined entirely by what you demonstrate in the evaluation process — not by years of experience on paper.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruitment Executive
description:
**Job Description: Recruitment Executive at IND**

**Position Title:** Recruitment Executive  
**Location:** Sovabazar, Kolkata  
**Work Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role:**

As a Recruitment Executive at IND, based in Sovabazar, Kolkata, you will play a key role in sourcing, attracting, and hiring the best talent to meet the dynamic needs of the organization. Reporting directly to the Managing Director’s Office (MDO), your role will involve handling end\-to\-end recruitment, establishing strong external networks, and proactively engaging in diverse activities to ensure the success of recruitment initiatives. This position requires a hands\-on approach, including physically visiting and building relationships with various organizations, educational institutions, and networks for sourcing talent.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Talent Acquisition:**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, selecting, and onboarding candidates.
* Explore and utilize diverse sourcing channels, including job portals, social media, referrals, campus recruitment, and in\-person networking, to attract top talent.
* Build and maintain relationships with colleges, universities, training institutes, and other organizations to create a robust talent pipeline.
* Visit external organizations, attend career fairs, and conduct outreach programs to expand the pool of prospective candidates.

**Candidate Evaluation and Engagement:**

* Conduct initial candidate screenings to assess qualifications, experience, and cultural fit.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and department heads, ensuring seamless candidate communication.
* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Support new hires during onboarding to ensure a smooth transition into the organization.

**Process Management and Strategy:**

* Work closely with the Managing Director’s Office to align recruitment efforts with organizational goals and priorities.
* Define and execute tri\-monthly, monthly, weekly, and daily recruitment objectives in collaboration with the MDO.
* Keep detailed records of recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-hire, quality of hires, and cost efficiency.
* Continuously improve recruitment processes to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.

**Networking and Outreach:**

* Actively engage with external organizations, colleges, and talent hubs to promote IND as an employer of choice.
* Establish partnerships with relevant organizations for sourcing candidates, including niche hiring needs.
* Represent IND at networking events, seminars, and job fairs to enhance the organization’s employer brand.

**Support for MDO and Diverse Activities:**

* Act as a point of coordination for recruitment\-related activities for the Managing Director’s Office.
* Be open to diverse and dynamic tasks beyond recruitment, as assigned by the MDO, to support organizational goals.
* Engage in activities that align with the strategic objectives of the organization, demonstrating flexibility and initiative.

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, with a preference for candidates with experience in external networking and outreach.
* Excellent communication skills in Bengali, Hindi, and English (verbal and written).
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to build relationships with external organizations and candidates.
* Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable with traveling locally and physically visiting organizations, colleges, and other institutions as part of recruitment efforts.
* Knowledge of recruitment tools and strategies, including job portals and social media platforms.

**Preferred Attributes:**

* Background in recruitment for educational, healthcare, or neurodevelopment\-focused organizations.
* Prior experience in campus hiring, networking, or relationship\-building with institutions.
* A growth\-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.
* Flexibility to engage in tasks beyond recruitment, as required by the Managing Director’s Office.

**Key Metrics for Success:**

* Quality of hires and their alignment with organizational goals.
* Time\-to\-hire for open positions and efficiency of the recruitment process.
* Effectiveness in building and maintaining external networks for sourcing.
* Success in achieving recruitment targets set by the Managing Director’s Office.
* Positive feedback from candidates and hiring managers regarding the recruitment process.

**Why Join IND?**

At IND, we are committed to creating meaningful change in the lives of children with Autism and other neurodevelopmental challenges. As a Recruitment Executive, you will play a critical role in building a team that supports our mission. This is an opportunity to engage in impactful work, grow professionally, and contribute to a transformative organization.

title: Nursing Superintendent
description:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** 

Ø Work lawfully, co\-operatively and amicably with all the medical and other nursing staffs.

Ø Responsible for day to day patient care to the allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for Bed Making, Mouth Care, Sponging, Personal Hygiene, Back care/ Skin care of Allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for drug administration (Follow 6R Policy), Checking bed side stock medicines, Feeding (Oral/Ryle’s tube/ Parental).

Ø Proper Maintenance of case sheet.

Ø Responsible for assisting in Doctor’s round, Procedures, Investigation/OT preparation of allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for assisting \& helping with all the necessary information of the patient during doctor’s round of the allocated patient.

Ø Responsible for hand over and takeover of inventories and medicines of the allocated patient and ward.

Ø Responsible for helping in elimination of waste and to maintain Hospital Infection Control.

Ø Responsible for providing psychological support to the allocated patient and their relatives. All nursing staff will be wearing black shoe with proper uniform on duty.

Ø You have to join duty before 10 minutes of scheduled time. Handover should be taken post checking inventory, stock medicine, and consumables.

Ø Handover should be carried out in beside with medicine card and hand over register.

Ø Using personal mobile on duty hours is not allowed.

Ø Morning staff on duty will go for lunch only after handing over and evening duty staff will take hand over post lunch. Lunch after hand over is not allowed.

Ø Evening duty staff have to attend weekly classes of Dr. Talapatra, Mr.Koushik Hazra, Microbiologist and any Consultant’s classes. Any non\-adherence will be treated as absence from duty.

Ø GDA will take part in sponging, bed making, urine pot and giving bed pan,.

Ø 2 hourly back care have to given for ICCU patient.

Ø Don’t take leave without information of Technician.

Ø If any uncertain problem arises in Department then immediate inform to related technical person.

Ø Register of handover, stock medicine, inventory, pathology, radiology, blood transfusion must have to maintain.

Ø All staff must have to respect to senior, don’t make noise with senior.

Ø Non\-functional machines information must be pass on to Technician.

Ø In case of OT’s PAC ( Pre anesthetic checkup ) must be ensured in coordination with Floor Manager.

Ø Ensure all vital statistics checkup properly before writing in the note sheet for example urine out, Blood Pressure etc.

Ø In case of discharge extra medicine should be returned to pharmacy.

Ø Discharge medicine dosages must be discussed with patient party while patient gets discharged.

Ø For outside Diagnostics / Pathology tests floor manager must be informed and proper register to be maintained. Patient file should not accompany with the patient.

Ø To maintain TAT (Turn Around Time) in line with NABH proper register should be maintained in all wards.

Ø In case of emergency RMO must be connected through ward Cell phone and recording must be presented while enquiry.

Ø Dietary restrictions must be maintained in consultation with Dietician.

Ø Blood requisition should be rooted through Doctor. Proper protocol for Blood Transfusion must be followed at every step.

Ø During discharge Inter Venous channel and other external fixation must be removed from patient’s body.

Ø Medicines brand name and expiry date must be precisely checked before giving to the patients.

Ø Responsible for maintaining co\-ordination between patient/family and the Doctor.

Ø Responsible for performing in bedside physiotherapy/Breathing Exercise, Heamo Dynamic Monitoring \& Recording, Assisting major and minor dressings, Inhalation and nebulization, IV cannulation injection, IV therapy \& blood transfusion, ECG.

Ø Responsible for performing in CBS Checking/Suction, Charting/Recording and assessment chart filing, position changing and bedside care of the patient.

Ø Maintain stock of Emergency medicines with other inventories and sterile equipment checking for expiry date.

Ø Responsible for handling and maintaining crash cart trolley with the help of Sister Incharge.

Ø Check the crash cart trolley on the daily basis and also at the time of shift changing.

Ø Supervise Laundry stock.

Ø Cleaning and antiseptic Dressing, Maintaining aseptic technique and hand washing of allocated patient.

Ø Maintaining Admission, Transfer, Discharge, DOR, DORB procedure and patient file.

Ø Maintaining the entire check list \& nursing assessment documentation.

Ø Supervising good hygiene of ward and patient’s toilet.

Ø Proper maintaining of humidifier in central oxygen line.

Ø Instrument handling and maintaining (Monitors, Pulse Oxymeter, Syringe Pump, Infusion Pump, ECG machine, Defibrillator, Cardiac Monitor, Ventilator, Pulse generator, Holter monitor, CVP line etc.).

Ø Proper communication of all the sentinel events to the nursing administration.

Ø Participating in service classes regularly arranged by HR Department.

Ø Report to Sister In charge of the unit in related to any nursing care problem during work and must carry out her order to the best of your ability.

Ø Involvement in direct patient care along with admission, discharge, transfer in \& out and death protocols.

Ø Bridging gap between patient's party \& doctors.

Ø Assisting the MS/Visiting Consultant/Nursing Super/RMO/MO in their rounds.

Ø Supervision of all staff in completing clinical assessment chart of every patient including MOM.

Ø Report any unwanted incident to Sister In Charge/ Nursing Super

Ø Maintaining discipline and awareness of hospital policies \& protocols.

Ø Maintaining crash cart protocol.

Ø Maintaining disposal of biomedical waste.

Ø Responsible for helping QC team in collecting data and feedbacks.

Ø Responsible for cleanliness and ventilation of wards, service rooms and sanitary area as well as to the cleanliness of cupboards, floor, utensils etc.

Ø Responsible for all activity sheets and updating sheet for proper billing.

Ø Responsible for diet prescribing/changing /discharge/investigation/reports awaited/pre \& post operative procedures/PAC done/pending.

Ø Maintenance of Ward equipments \& biomedical equipments \& linen.

Ø Communicate with the Sister In Charge / Nursing Super in case of any infringement of misconduct committed by patient or their relatives.

Ø Responsible for maintaining Hospital Infection Control in collaboration with Sister in Charge/ Nursing Super and Infection Control committee.

Ø Exercise particular care in the event of discharge, transfer or death of patient.

Ø Responsible for special care for vulnerable patients.

Ø Responsible for end of life care procedure.

Ø Responsible for maintaining colour codes of patient.

Ø To perform all other duties as and when required for the better service of the hospital assigned by competent authority.

Ø The aforesaid work profile is illustrative in nature not exhaustive.

Reports / Records:

Records to be maintained are:

· Admission, transfer and discharge

· Stock Register of Medicine, Syringe.

· Stock Register of Linen of patient etc.

· Crash cart check list

· Register quality indicators.

· Event Register.

· Notifiable disease register.

· Handover register.

· Patient complaint book.

· Master equipment list.

· Equipment movement register.

· Equipment complaint book.

description:

**Job Title: Sales Manager**

**Role Overview:**  
The Sales Manager oversees all sales activities within the organization and is responsible for developing and implementing sales strategies to drive growth and meet or exceed sales targets. * **Sales Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify areas for improvement and develop actionable insights to optimize sales performance.
* **Forecasting and Budgeting:** Prepare sales forecasts and budgets based on market analysis and business objectives. Monitor performance against targets and take corrective actions as needed.

* **Collaboration:** Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and customer service, to ensure alignment of sales strategies with overall business goals.
* **Reporting:** Generate regular sales reports and present findings to senior management, providing updates on sales performance, market trends, and opportunities for growth.

* Proven track record of success in sales, with experience in sales management preferred.
* Strong leadership and motivational skills, with the ability to inspire and coach a diverse team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and negotiate effectively.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and exceeding targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, or a related field (MBA is a plus).
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.

**Working Conditions:**

* The Sales Manager typically works in an office environment but may also spend time meeting with clients and attending industry events.
* This role may require occasional travel to meet with clients or attend conferences.

**Salary Range:**  
The salary for a Sales Manager varies depending on factors such as experience, industry, location, and company size. On average, the salary range for a Sales Manager is $60,000 to $150,000 per year, with additional bonuses and commissions based on performance.

**Conclusion:**  
A Sales Manager plays a critical role in driving revenue growth and maximizing profitability for an organization. By leading a high\-performing sales team and implementing effective sales strategies, the Sales Manager contributes to the overall success and competitiveness of the business.

title: Global Talent Acquisition Senior Specialist – Operations CoE
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


You will work at the core of BCG’s global Talent Acquisition ecosystem, connecting policies, tools, and processes to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and ensure compliant operations worldwide. Your main responsibilities will include:

 **Policy Governance and Compliance**

* Own and continuously evolve global Talent Acquisition policies and governance frameworks to enable compliant, risk\-mitigated operations with a strong focus on data privacy and protection
* Drive alignment across Legal, the Data Protection Office (DPO), Responsible AI (RAI), and other stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into scalable operational practices
* Lead the development and deployment of GenAI\-enabled solutions that improve policy accessibility, accelerate updates, and strengthen adoption and adherence globally
* Identify policy gaps, compliance risks, and operational trends, providing actionable recommendations to improve governance effectiveness and reduce risk exposure

 **Tool Access Management and Coordination**

* Own user access governance for core TA platforms, including operational oversight, access structures, role models, and continuous optimization of UAM processes
* Drive harmonized access management practices across regions and business units to improve consistency, transparency, and operational efficiency
* Analyze platform usage patterns, access trends, and user behaviors to generate actionable insights and recommend improvements to platform governance and user experience
* Lead and grow a global user community that promotes knowledge sharing, adoption, and scalable best practices across recruiting teams

 **Process Harmonization and Insights**

* Lead the analysis and harmonization of recruiting processes across local, regional, and business unit teams to identify root causes, eliminate inefficiencies, and define scalable best practices
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by translating operational findings and stakeholder feedback into practical, high\-impact recommendations
* Own KPI frameworks and reporting approaches that generate meaningful insights into policy effectiveness, operational performance, and process improvement opportunities
* Drive stakeholder alignment through structured governance forums, clear decision documentation, and end\-to\-end ownership of follow\-up actions and implementation tracking

 **CoE Positioning and Impact**

* Strengthen the GTA OPS Center of Excellence (CoE) as a trusted global authority for recruiting operations, governance, and process excellence
* Lead the GTA OPS Functional Leadership Community (FLC), driving collaboration, alignment, and exchange of scalable operational best practices across teams
* Partner with Talent Acquisition Learning \& Development to design and deliver practical, up\-to\-date learning solutions that improve adoption of global policies, tools, and processes

  

What You'll Bring

* 4\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, HR operations, governance, or a related field
* Proven ability to drive operational improvements, manage cross\-functional initiatives, and deliver results in global, matrixed environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, including experience translating data and operational insights into practical recommendations
* Experience working across global stakeholders and navigating complex organizational environments with clarity and sound judgment
* Strong digital fluency, including Microsoft 365, reporting tools, and GenAI\-enabled applications
* Practical understanding of data privacy, compliance, and risk considerations related to HR or recruiting operations
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced, evolving environment


Please note this position is not restricted solely to the responsibilities listed above and that the job scope and responsibilities are subject to change

  

Who You'll Work With

* You will be part of BCG's Global Talent Acquisition team, reporting to the Senior Manager and Head of BCG’s Global TA OPS CoE
* You will collaborate with global stakeholders across Process, Product, Data, IT, Finance, Procurement, and Legal
* The working environment reflects the best of BCG: collaborative, trust\-based, dynamic, and strongly outcome\-oriented

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Taking ownership of complex operational topics and independently driving initiatives from problem identification through implementation
* Applying structured problem\-solving and critical thinking to identify root causes, generate insights, and recommend scalable improvements
* Influencing and aligning stakeholders across global, cross\-functional environments through clear and persuasive communication
* Translating data, operational trends, and user feedback into actionable recommendations and measurable process improvements
* Leveraging technology, automation, and GenAI solutions to improve operational effectiveness and user experience
* Managing sensitive and confidential information with integrity, sound judgment, and strong risk awareness

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

 The Senior Manager – HR will own the people agenda for TTC, aligning HR strategy with the firm’s business objectives and growth trajectory. This is not a back\-office HR role – it requires someone who understands how a consulting firm operates commercially, can engage credibly with Partners and practice leads, and can build the people infrastructure that a scaling professional services organisation needs.
 



 The role spans the full breadth of HR: talent acquisition, performance management, organisational development, compensation, compliance, and culture. The successful candidate will bring both strategic thinking and a willingness to be hands\-on – at a firm of TTC’s size, the HR leader must operate comfortably across both levels.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. HR Strategy \& Organisational Development** 




 •    Partner with the leadership team to shape and implement the HR strategy aligned with TTC’s business plan and growth priorities
 



 •    Drive organisational development initiatives – including team structuring, role clarity, leadership development, and culture building
 



 •    Advise Partners on people\-related dimensions of business decisions: project staffing, team composition, capacity planning
 



 •    Define and embed TTC’s employer value proposition to support talent attraction and retention
 



**2\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 




 •    Lead recruitment across consulting, technical, and support roles – ensuring quality of hire, speed, and alignment with TTC’s positioning
 



 •    Build and manage sourcing channels: campus partnerships, referral programmes, specialist recruiters, and lateral hiring pipelines
 



 •    Own workforce planning in coordination with engagement leads – anticipating demand based on project pipeline and utilisation data
 



**3\. Performance Management \& Talent Development** 




 •    Design and run the performance management cycle: goal\-setting, mid\-year check\-ins, annual reviews, calibration, and outcome communication
 



 •    Build structured learning and development interventions – onboarding programmes, consulting skills training, leadership tracks
 



 •    Identify and nurture high\-potential talent; develop succession planning frameworks for critical roles
 



 •    Strengthen employee engagement and retention strategies grounded in data, not assumptions
 



**4\. Compensation, Benefits \& Compliance** 




 •    Manage compensation structures, benchmarking, and annual salary review processes; ensure internal equity and market alignment
 



 •    Oversee benefits administration and total rewards positioning
 



 •    Ensure full compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements (PF, ESI, Gratuity, PT), and internal policies
 



 •    Lead POSH implementation and maintain a safe, respectful workplace environment
 



 •    Maintain HR documentation and audit readiness at all times
 



**5\. Employee Relations \& Culture** 




 •    Act as a trusted advisor to employees and leadership on people matters – with sensitivity, fairness, and confidentiality
 



 •    Handle grievances and employee concerns; manage conflict resolution with maturity
 



 •    Foster a culture of openness, accountability, and professional respect – appropriate for a consulting firm that works with institutional clients
 



**6\. Team Leadership** 




 •    Lead and develop the HR team; build capability in HR business partnering, operations, and organisational development
 



 •    Drive a culture of process rigour, data discipline, and continuous improvement within the function
 



 •    Serve as the HR interface for Partners and practice leads – translating business needs into people actions
 



  





**Education \& Experience** 




 •    MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or related field from a reputed institution
 



 •    10–15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5–7 years in an HR leadership role
 



 •    Prior experience in consulting, professional services, or knowledge\-driven organisations strongly preferred
 



 •    Demonstrated experience in organisational development, talent management, and strategic HR – not just HR operations
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Strong grasp of HR frameworks, talent management, and organisational design
 



 •    High emotional intelligence; able to navigate sensitive conversations and build trust across levels
 



 •    Analytical mindset – comfortable using HR data and metrics to inform decisions, not just intuition
 



 •    Excellent written and verbal communication; able to present to leadership with clarity and confidence
 



 •    Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a lean team environment
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 •    Someone who understands that HR in a consulting firm is a business function, not an administrative one
 



 •    Comfort operating in a commercial environment – TTC serves development sector clients but runs as a for\-profit professional services firm
 



 •    High integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive organisational and people matters
 



 •    Genuine interest in building institutions – not just filling seats
 



 •    Ownership mindset – you treat TTC’s people outcomes as your personal accountability

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Sr. TA Partner Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Support in designing and executing employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice, leveraging digital platforms and recruitment marketing tools.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.


**Additional Roles And Responsibilities Include**
* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* Align and ensure the Headcount report is in alignment with Global HR and Finance teams.
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* Support on designing Recruitment policies and Manuals when required. Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 10 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Nil
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time
