title: Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
**About Us**
 Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.
   

  

 In\-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in\-office workdays
   

  

**About The Role**
 Millions of people use Notion — and this number is increasing every day. That means millions of people trust us to deliver a fast, reliable, and secure experience, and we value this more than anything. We want to keep earning trust, while also continuing to amaze our users with the tools they can build in Notion. The Developer Experience team is responsible for architecting, implementing, and scaling the tools and frameworks that Notion developers use to build Notion. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about solving engineering productivity challenges, have deep empathy for other developers, and love to communicate with engineers. You don't need to have experience in this domain but willing to advocate for developer experience is the key.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* Collaborate with engineers across the company to deliver an industry\-leading developer experience, along the way working deeply with tools like the TypeScript language server, lint tooling, and the Notion CLI to improve developers’ day to day experience.
* Work on the bleeding edge of tooling performance, researching and evaluating new tools and keeping up with new developments in the developer experience space in the JS ecosystem.
* Work deeply with GitHub and our CI systems to help ensure engineers can merge their code quickly and safely. We aim for all PR CI pipelines to finish within 15 minutes!
* Take ownership of our development environment and toolchain, and contribute to novel projects across the company to deliver impact.


**Skills You'll Need To Bring**
* Over 8 years of hands\-on software development experience, thriving in fast\-paced and dynamic environments.
* A drive to make developers’ lives better: you have a strong interest in keeping engineers in their flow state through better tooling. You like to think critically about the workflows engineers use in their day to day work, finding bottlenecks and thinking outside of the box to find ways to pave a better golden path for engineers to follow.
* A focus on user experience: you bring care and craft to the user experience you build into your products. Your work emphasizes simplicity, supportability, and ease\-of\-use, and you communicate clearly with other teams and engineers to get feedback on where we can improve.
* Multitasker and present: you like interrupts especially if this is blocking engineers. You switch between your project work and day to day developer experience challenges.
* Interest in learning how things work: you love to learn how the tools you use work at a fundamental level. You get excited at the idea of digging into third\-party source code to understand how they work and find new ways to use them.
* Pragmatic and business\-oriented: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly. You don't just go after cool stuff—you understand the balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line. To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.
* You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.


**Nice To Haves**
* Familiarity with TypeScript, especially in ways to keep it running smoothly in a large codebase.
* An interest in automated testing and familiarity with testing best practices.
* Past experience with React and common tooling like React Testing Library.
* Past experience on developer experience teams or related tools.


 We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
   

  

 By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.

title: Recruitment & Training Coordinator
description:
Role Summary

The Recruitment \& Training Coordinator will be responsible for supporting manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, employee training, and skill development across Unimech’s foundry, machine shop, quality, maintenance, stores, and office functions. The role will ensure that the right people are hired, properly inducted, trained for their responsibilities, and continuously developed to meet Unimech’s operational and growth requirements.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment Coordination

* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements.
* Prepare and publish job postings on platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, WhatsApp groups, local agencies, and recruitment portals.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule interviews with department heads and management.
* Maintain a recruitment tracker with candidate status, feedback, joining dates, and salary expectations.
* Coordinate with contractors and agencies for labour requirements, especially for foundry operations.
* Support hiring for operators, helpers, technicians, inspectors, office staff, and junior management roles.

2\. Interview \& Selection Support

* Conduct initial screening calls with candidates.
* Verify basic experience, salary expectations, notice period, location preference, and willingness to work in a manufacturing environment.
* Arrange trade tests or practical evaluations where required.
* Collect interview feedback from technical teams.
* Support offer discussions and joining coordination.

3\. Onboarding \& Joining Formalities

* Ensure new employees complete joining documents, ID proof, bank details, photographs, and statutory forms.
* Coordinate induction for new joiners.
* Explain company rules, attendance requirements, leave procedure, safety expectations, and reporting structure.
* Ensure new employees are introduced to their department head and team.
* Maintain employee records in physical and digital formats.

4\. Training Coordination

* Identify training needs in discussion with department heads.
* Prepare and maintain a training calendar for workers, staff, supervisors, and new joiners.
* Coordinate internal training sessions on safety, quality, process discipline, ERP usage, inspection practices, and workplace behaviour.
* Track training attendance and effectiveness.
* Maintain training records for audits and customer requirements.
* Follow up with employees and supervisors to ensure training learnings are implemented on the shop floor.

5\. Skill Matrix \& Competency Development

* Maintain department\-wise skill matrices for foundry, machining, NDT, inspection, stores, maintenance, and office teams.
* Track employee skill levels and identify gaps.
* Coordinate cross\-training and upskilling plans.
* Support development of multi\-skilled employees to improve flexibility in production.
* Monitor progress of trainees, helpers, and junior staff.

6\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain recruitment files, interview records, appointment letters, training records, and employee documents.
* Support HR documentation required for audits, customer visits, and statutory compliance.
* Ensure training records are properly filed and retrievable.
* Assist in maintaining records related to safety training, quality training, and process training.

7\. Employee Communication \& Follow\-Up

* Act as a coordinator between HR, management, department heads, employees, and labour contractors.
* Follow up with new employees during the initial joining period.
* Escalate attendance, behaviour, or performance concerns to HR/management.
* Support communication of company policies, discipline requirements, and training initiatives.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Good communication skills in English, Malayalam and Tamil; Hindi will be an added advantage.
* Ability to speak confidently with candidates, workers, supervisors, and managers.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing recruitment.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good record\-keeping and documentation ability.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and job portals.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Practical, disciplined, and shop\-floor oriented approach.

Preferred Experience

* 1–4 years of experience in HR, recruitment, training coordination, or manpower coordination.
* Experience in a manufacturing, foundry, machining, engineering, or industrial environment preferred.
* Fresh HR graduates may also be considered if they are strong in communication and follow\-up.

Key Performance Indicators

* Time taken to close open positions.
* Quality and retention of new hires.
* Completion of joining formalities on time.
* Training calendar adherence.
* Training attendance and documentation accuracy.
* Skill matrix updates and closure of identified skill gaps.
* Support provided to departments for manpower availability.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:
**Key Responsibilities:**


**Recruitment Support:** Assist in the recruitment process by posting job openings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and communicating with candidates.

 Music playing in the background, coffee brewing in the studio, and people casually turning random thoughts into real ideas.

Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides a comprehensive range of solutions in the areas of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider, and Oracle services to customers across the globe. Combining our extensive industry experience and global reach, we have built strong capabilities across multiple industry verticals.  

  

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution\-focused Administrative Manager to manage and streamline office administration, facilities, vendor management, employee support operations, and overall workplace governance for our India operations.

  

**Position Details**  

  

**Role:** Administrative Manager / Admin Operations Manager  

**Location:** Bengaluru  

**Work Mode:** Work from Office  

**Experience:** 8–15 Years  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

  

**Role Overview**  

  

The Administrative Manager will be responsible for managing the day\-to\-day administrative operations of the organization while ensuring smooth office functioning, compliance, infrastructure coordination, employee facilities management, travel coordination, procurement support, and vendor governance.  

  

This role requires a strong ownership mindset, operational discipline, cost management focus, and the ability to support a fast\-growing technology organization operating in a dynamic environment.  

  

The ideal candidate should be capable of handling administration independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with leadership, HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Office Administration \& Facility Management**  

  

Manage complete office administration and daily operational activities  

Ensure smooth functioning of office infrastructure, seating, meeting rooms, cafeteria, housekeeping, security, and utilities  

Coordinate maintenance activities for office premises and equipment  

Ensure workplace hygiene, safety, and operational readiness at all times  

Manage office expansion, relocation, and infrastructure setup activities if required  

  

**Vendor \& Procurement Management**  

  

Manage office vendors including housekeeping, security, travel, facility maintenance, internet providers, transport, and pantry vendors  

Negotiate pricing, contracts, renewals, and SLAs with vendors  

Track vendor performance and ensure timely issue resolution  

Support procurement activities for office assets, consumables, and operational requirements  

Maintain asset inventory and procurement records  

  

**Employee Support Operations**  

  

Support employee onboarding logistics including workstation readiness, ID cards, seating allocation, and access coordination  

Manage employee travel bookings, accommodation arrangements, and transport coordination  

Handle guest management and visitor coordination  

Ensure a smooth employee experience related to administrative support services  

  

**Compliance \& Governance**  

  

Ensure adherence to office policies, statutory requirements, safety standards, and internal governance processes  

Coordinate with Finance, HR, IT, and leadership teams for operational compliance  

Maintain administration\-related documentation, contracts, invoices, and records  

Support audits and operational reviews when required  

  

**Budget \& Cost Management**  

  

Track administration and facilities budgets  

Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization  

Monitor recurring operational expenses and vendor billing  

Prepare MIS reports and administration dashboards for leadership review  

  

**Coordination \& Leadership**  

  

Coordinate with cross\-functional teams for the smooth execution of operational activities  

Manage administration support staff and facility teams  

Drive accountability, discipline, and responsiveness within the admin function  

Act as a single point of contact for office operational escalations  

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**  

  

8–15 years of experience in administration, facilities management, workplace operations, or corporate services  

Experience managing administration for IT services, technology, or corporate organizations is preferred  

Strong vendor management and negotiation skills  

Good understanding of office infrastructure, facilities operations, and compliance requirements  

Strong coordination and multitasking abilities  

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills  

Strong ownership mindset and execution capability  

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and reporting tools  

Ability to work in a fast\-paced and evolving environment  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Experience handling administration for medium to large corporate offices  

Exposure to budgeting and cost control  

Experience managing multiple vendors and operational teams  

Familiarity with workplace safety and statutory compliance practices  

Prior experience supporting leadership teams and fast\-growing organizations  

  

**What We Are Looking For**

With innovative technology, a strong distribution network and long\-standing relationships with some of the world’s largest employers, we are today providing financial security to millions of people globally.


Sun Life is a leading financial services company that helps our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives, with strong insurance, asset management, investments, and financial advice portfolios. At Sun Life, our asset management business draws on the talent and experience of professionals from around the globe.


**SLGS(Sun Life Global Solutions)** provides Technology and Business Solutions to Sun Life businesses globally. Started in 2006, since then SLGS has achieved scale, growth, and operational maturity. Asia Service Centres today has more than 1100 Engineers, 200\+ AWS professionals, and a group of Certified Actuaries. They deliver various complex business solutions. The SLGS core digital competencies are cloud, mobile, data analytics, visualization, and RPA. Digital transformation, for us, is not just about technology advancement and application, but also about enabling business strategy. We enable all this with the latest technologies, data\-driven insights, skillsets, talent and change frameworks.

Our Client Impact strategy is motivated by the need to create an inclusive culture, empowered by highly engaged people. We are entering a new world that focuses on doing purpose driven work. The kind that fills your day with excitement and determination, because when you love what you do, it never feels like work. We want to create an environment where you feel empowered to take action and are surrounded by people who challenge you, support you and inspire you to become the best version of yourself. As an employer, we not only want to attract top talent, but we want you to have the best Sun Life Experience.


We strive to Shine Together, Make Life Brighter \& Shape the Future!

description:
**Position:** MSW Officer

**Location**: Baramati, Tal \- Baramati, Dist \- Pune

**Department:** Labour Welfare / Human Resources

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Summary:**

The Welfare Officer is responsible for ensuring the well\-being and welfare of sugarcane harvesting labourers employed by the sugar factory. This role includes overseeing living and working conditions, addressing grievances, facilitating access to essential services. The Welfare Officer acts as a bridge between the workers and management to promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

**1\. Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD):** 

\- Conduct HRDD assessments in coordination with mill management, identifying and mitigating risks to workers’ rights.

\- Develop and implement strategies to address workplace human rights issues, with particular focus on women’s welfare and gender equity.

\- Provide training on human rights principles, including prevention of harassment, gender sensitivity, and anti\-discrimination practices.

\- Collaborate with the sustainability manager of client companies to meet HRDD standards and ensure transparent communication.

\- Grievance Mechanisms: Support the development and monitoring of safe, anonymous grievance redressal mechanisms.

**2\. Occupational Health and Safety (OHS):** 

**\-** Develop, implement, and enforce OHS policies and practices at the workplace.

\- Conduct safety audits, risk assessments, and site inspections to identify and resolve hazards.

\- Organize training programs to promote a culture of safety, focusing on vulnerable groups, including women and seasonal workers.

\- Investigate and document workplace accidents, ensuring that corrective and preventive actions are in place.

**3\. Fair Working Conditions and Women’s Welfare:** 

**\-** Ensure compliance with fair wages, reasonable working hours, and equitable treatment of all workers.

\- Advocate for and address women’s issues, including workplace safety, health, hygiene, and childcare support.

\- Work with HR teams to establish policies for maternity benefits, equal opportunities, and grievance redressal mechanisms for women workers.

\- Mediate conflicts and resolve grievances, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

**4\. Field Visits and Worker Engagement:** 

\- Conduct regular field visits to harvesting workers' camps to evaluate living conditions, access to health facilities, and compliance with labor laws.

\- Engage with workers to identify their concerns, ensuring their voices are incorporated into management decisions.

\- Document findings from field visits and prepare actionable recommendations for improvements.

**5\. Grievance Mechanisms:**

\- Support the development and implementation of safe, anonymous grievance redressal mechanisms for workers.

\- Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of grievance systems, ensuring accessibility and fairness for all workers.

\- Address grievances promptly and transparently, maintaining a record of complaints and resolutions.

\- Conduct periodic reviews to improve grievance mechanisms based on feedback and best practices.

**6\. Stakeholder Coordination:** 

**\-** Act as the primary liaison between mill management, client representatives, and internal HRDD and sustainability teams.

\- Collaborate with external stakeholders, including NGOs, auditors, and government bodies, to promote compliance with human rights and safety standards.

\- Regularly update the sustainability manager of the company’s clients on progress, challenges, and mitigation strategies.

**7\. Reporting and Documentation:**

\- Prepare detailed reports on HRDD, OHS, and gender\-related initiatives for internal and external stakeholders. Maintain accurate records of inspections, incidents, and resolutions to support compliance and continuous improvement efforts.  Track and analyze KPIs related to HRDD, OHS, and women’s welfare programs.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

\- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Social Work / Rural Development / Labour Welfare or related field.

\- Minimum 2–6 years of experience in labour welfare, preferably in agriculture or factory settings.

\- Knowledge of local language and familiarity with rural labour issues.

\- Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

**Desirable Attributes:**

\- Empathetic and people\-centric approach.

\- Willingness to travel to field areas or cane harvesting sites if and when required.

description:
**Job Summary:**

The **HR Manager – Labour** is responsible for managing and maintaining healthy employee–employer relations, ensuring compliance with all labour laws, handling union matters, maintaining statutory records, and ensuring a productive and disciplined workforce. The role requires a blend of strong communication, legal understanding, and interpersonal skills to maintain a harmonious industrial environment.

**Key Responsibilities:1\. Labour Relations \& Employee Welfare**

* Maintain peaceful industrial relations by managing communication between management and workers/unions.
* Resolve grievances of workmen promptly to prevent disputes and maintain workforce harmony.
* Conduct regular meetings with union representatives and employee welfare committees.
* Implement welfare measures such as canteen, transport, housing, safety, and health facilities.

**2\. Compliance \& Statutory Management**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws — *Factories Act, Industrial Disputes Act, Payment of Wages Act, Minimum Wages Act, Employees’ Provident Fund Act, ESI Act, etc.*
* Maintain statutory registers, records, and returns as per government norms.
* Coordinate with government departments during inspections, audits, and labour office visits.
* Prepare and submit periodic compliance reports to management.

**3\. Workforce Management**

* Oversee attendance, leave management, overtime, and shift scheduling for workers.
* Manage contract labour through coordination with contractors and ensure adherence to *Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act*.
* Conduct manpower planning and ensure adequate workforce availability for production.
* Handle disciplinary actions, domestic inquiries, and misconduct cases following standing orders.

**4\. Training \& Development**

* Identify training needs of workers and conduct skill upgradation programs.
* Arrange awareness sessions on safety, hygiene, and labour rights.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement.

**5\. Communication \& Reporting**

* Act as a liaison between factory management and HR head office.
* Prepare MIS reports on labour strength, absenteeism, turnover, and grievances.
* Support in collective bargaining and wage negotiations.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience:**

* **Education:** MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management, Labour Welfare, or Industrial Relations.
* **Experience:** 5–10 years of experience in HR \& IR functions, preferably in a manufacturing or plant environment.
* **Knowledge:** Thorough understanding of Indian labour laws, industrial relations practices, and statutory compliance.
* **Skills:** Negotiation, conflict resolution, leadership, communication, documentation, and government liaison.

**Key Competencies:**

* High integrity and confidentiality in handling employee issues.

* Sound judgment and decision\-making capabilities.

We are looking for a research\-driven **Equity Research Analyst** to support a private trading and investment desk with fundamental research, sector analysis, swing ideas, long\-term investment opportunities, safe stock identification, and multibagger research.

The candidate should be able to analyse listed companies, read financial statements, study annual reports, track quarterly results, understand sector cycles, and prepare concise stock notes for decision\-making.

This role is not for giving random market tips. The candidate must provide structured research with clear reasoning, valuation comfort, risks, and thesis tracking.

* Company overview
* Business model
* Revenue segments
* Promoter background
* Management quality
* Financial performance
* Debt levels
* Cash flows
* Profit margins
* Return ratios
* Valuation
* Growth triggers
* Risks
* Peer comparison
* Investment thesis
* Exit conditions

* Quality compounders
* Safe long\-term stocks
* Sector leaders
* Low\-debt companies
* Cash\-flow strong companies
* High ROE/ROCE businesses
* Consistent profit growers
* Companies with strong moats

* Emerging sectors
* Turnaround stories

title: Intern - Procurement & Resource Development
description:
**Intern: Procurement \& Resource Development**

**Place of Posting: Purnea, BIhar**

**About Company:**

AgroKisan, a brand owned by Krishi Samriddhi Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative Agritech startups, leveraging cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize agriculture in India. AgroKisan focus on precision farming, agriculture value chain, and sustainable solutions for efficiency and resilience in agricultural sector. With a commitment to modernizing practices, AgroKisan play a vital role in shaping a more sustainable and productive future for Indian Agriculture Ecosystem. We are supported by Govt. of Bihar and incubated under Indian Institute of Technology, Patna.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Intern to join our Agribusiness team. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various aspects of agricultural industry. This role offers exposure to a fast\-paced and innovative environment where you will work closely with our sales and marketing professionals to support our business objectives.

**Role Overview**

The Intern – Procurement (Agri Commodity) \& Resource Development will be responsible for sourcing agricultural commodities, managing field\-level procurement operations, and developing a strong network of farmers, FPOs, vendors, and field resources. The role ensures high\-quality, cost\-effective procurement while building sustainable relationships across the agriculture value chain. It also involves developing and training field partners, enabling efficient supply aggregation, and strengthening resource planning for ongoing agritech operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Agri Commodity Procurement**

* Identify and onboard farmers, FPOs/FPCs, aggregators, and traders for commodity sourcing.
* Conduct market research to track commodity prices, demand patterns, and seasonal availability.
* Negotiate procurement terms, quality parameters, and logistics with suppliers.
* Ensure timely procurement of commodities such as fruits, vegetables, grains, spices, pulses, or any crop aligned with company operations.
* Coordinate quality checks during procurement and ensure adherence to grading and standard specifications.
* Support contract farming or buy\-back arrangements with growers where applicable.

**2\. Field Resource Development \& Network Expansion**

* Develop a robust field network including farmers, FPOs, community leaders, agri\-input dealers, and rural micro\-entrepreneurs.
* Train and support field partners on procurement processes, quality parameters, and digital reporting tools.
* Conduct field visits to assess crop readiness, farmer engagement, and resource availability.
* Build a database of field resources to support sourcing, aggregation, and logistics operations.
* Identify new sourcing clusters and build market linkages in potential agri\-growing regions.

**3\. Supply Chain \& Operational Support**

* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and last\-mile pickup from sourcing locations to warehouses or processing centers.
* Work closely with operations and quality teams to ensure a seamless procurement\-to\-delivery pipeline.
* Assist in planning procurement volumes based on demand forecasts and operational needs.
* Ensure minimal wastage, efficient handling, and cost\-effective aggregation.

**4\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, farmers, FPO leaders, and local market stakeholders.
* Conduct periodic supplier evaluations based on quality, reliability, and pricing.
* Resolve field\-level issues related to quality disputes, procurement delays, or logistics challenges.
* Collaborate with government agencies, NGOs, or agri institutions for field\-level resource development.

**5\. Resource Planning, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain updated records of procurement volumes, sourcing locations, farmer databases, vendor details, and field activities.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on procurement performance, price trends, and field resource development.
* Ensure documentation compliance including purchase orders, agreements, receipts, and quality reports.
* Use digital tools or ERP systems to log procurement and field data accurately.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred.

**Work Experience**

* Freshers can also apply
* Prior experience in agri commodity procurement, field sourcing, supply chain, or rural operations will be prefered.
* Experience working with farmers, FPOs, mandi operations, rural networks, or agritech companies is highly desirable.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of agri commodities, market dynamics, crop cycles, and quality standards.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and vendor management skills.
* Ability to build rapport with farmers and rural stakeholders.
* Knowledge of mandi operations, auction systems, and procurement compliance.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, procurement tools, and mobile\-based field reporting apps.
* Willingness to travel extensively to sourcing clusters.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Field\-focused attitude with problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with empathy toward farmers and rural communities.
* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.
* Ability to handle pressure and dynamic procurement requirements.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of agriculture, technology, and supply chain innovation.
* Hands\-on exposure to emerging agritech business models.
* Career growth in procurement, rural operations, and supplier development.
* Direct impact on farmer livelihoods and sustainable sourcing.

We are looking for a confident and well\-spoken **Tele Caller** who will be responsible for calling all leads generated through digital marketing campaigns such as Facebook, Instagram, Google, WhatsApp, website inquiries, and other online platforms.

The main responsibility of this role is to quickly connect with interested customers, understand their requirements, share basic product information, qualify the lead, and pass serious inquiries to the sales team for follow\-up and closure.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead Calling**
* Call all leads received from digital marketing campaigns.
* Make the first call as quickly as possible after the lead is received.
* Follow up with leads who do not answer or ask to be called later.
* **Lead Qualification**
* Understand the customer’s requirement, project type, location, and budget.
* Identify whether the lead is an architect, interior designer, builder, contractor, dealer, or direct customer.

* **Product Explanation**

* Ensure no lead is missed or left unattended.
* **Follow\-Up Management**
* Call customers again as per follow\-up schedule.
* Send reminders, product details, and meeting confirmations.
* Keep regular contact until the lead is closed, rejected, or handed over fully to sales.
* **Daily Reporting**
* Submit daily call reports.

* Good communication skills in **Gujarati, Hindi, and basic English**

Work Experience Preferred

* Telecalling for interior products, paints, real estate, construction material, furniture, tiles, or related industries

Performance Expectations

The Tele Caller will be expected to:

* Call every new lead on time
* Maintain proper follow\-up records
* Increase the percentage of connected and qualified leads
* Support the sales team with genuine and complete lead information
* Help improve conversion from digital marketing campaigns

Key Performance Indicators

* Number of calls made daily
* Number of leads connected

 Renate is Looking for: Founder's Associate
 



 The Role As Founder's Associate at Renate, you are the operational nerve center of the company. This is not an administrative seat. You are the Founder's shadow. You run the day\-to\-day machinery of the business while the Founder drives sales, product, and strategy. You own everything internal so the Founder can focus on everything external. When something needs to get done and there is no one else to do it, you do it. When a process does not exist, you build it. When something breaks, you fix it before anyone notices. You report directly to the Founder\-CEO.
 



  





 Your Impact
 


* Run daily office operations end\-to\-end, including schedules, meetings, travel, logistics, supplies, internet, courier, and maintenance, without friction
* Track all expenses, invoices, and payments; coordinate with the CA for GST, TDS, and compliance filings; manage Razorpay payouts, vendor payments, and petty cash
* Maintain clean, audit\-ready financial records at all times
* Handle internal HR, including onboarding new hires and interns, offer letters, attendance, documentation, and payroll processing
* Be the first point of contact for any team member's operational needs
* Maintain all official records and compliance, including incorporation certificates, MOUs, NDAs, contracts, insurance, and regulatory filings, so nothing expires, nothing is missing, and nothing is unsigned
* Manage vendor and service\-provider relationships, procurement, deliveries, and field\-ops coordination including intern deployment across Mumbai
* Run chief\-of\-staff functions, including preparing agendas, briefs, and background materials for the Founder's meetings, tracking action items, following up on deliverables, and serving as the Founder's operational filter
* Flex into any function, including covering for the BD Manager when needed, handling client escalations, and coordinating with legal counsel on notices, as the failsafe for every function in the company



  





 What You Bring
 


* 2 to 5 years in operations, EA, or chief of staff roles in a startup or fast\-paced environment
* Obsessive organization, where you do not drop things and do not need to be reminded
* Strong written and verbal communication in English and Hindi
* Comfort with numbers, including basic accounting, expense tracking, and budgeting
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and basic Indian business compliance
* Fluency with Google Workspace, Notion (or equivalent), WhatsApp Business, and the Razorpay dashboard
* Zero ego about small tasks and high capacity for handling large ones
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and operate without detailed instructions

**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and advance numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of employee relations, labor relations, human resources, operations or related field experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant professional experience

At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

* Knowledge in Organization Development, HR Management, Industrial Relations, or related field is a plus.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Network Engineer \- Data Center Operations** 




 Experience\-2 to 5 years
 



 Location: Noida
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 Network Engineer is responsible for delivering onsite network deployment, installation, and maintenance services. The role involves performing rack and stack activities, IOS upgrades, and device health validation for a range of network infrastructure components including switches, routers, servers, and wireless access points.
 



  





 This position requires hands\-on technical expertise, attention to detail, and effective coordination with remote support and client teams to ensure smooth execution and compliance with service delivery standards and SLAs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Onsite Deployment \& Installation (Rack and Stack)** 



* Perform rack and stack installation of network and server hardware including switches, routers, servers, and access points (APs).
* Install SFP modules, stacking cables, power cords, and network uplinks as per design and project requirements.
* Ensure proper labeling, cable management, and adherence to rack design and airflow guidelines.
* Mount devices (up to 3 meters in height) securely and safely, following all EHS standards.



**Device Configuration \& IOS Upgrade** 



* Execute IOS/firmware upgrades and confirm version compliance post\-upgrade.
* Validate successful device boot, configuration integrity, and module recognition.
* Collaborate with remote engineers for configuration application, testing, and verification.



**Device Health Check \& Validation (POST)** 



* Conduct Power\-On Self\-Test (POST) validation for each installed device.
* Verify interface status, module health, LED indicators, and power redundancy.
* Identify and report any faulty or non\-functional hardware for immediate escalation.



**Wireless Access Point (AP) Installation** 



* Mount and connect APs at designated locations according to deployment plans.
* Ensure secure installation, correct positioning, and power/connectivity validation.
* Note: This role does not include site surveys or signal validation—installation only.



**Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate logs of all installed devices, serial numbers, and cable details.
* Update rack elevation diagrams and cable matrices post\-installation.
* Provide before\-and\-after photos and summary reports for delivery validation and audit purposes.



**Coordination \& Communication** 



* Coordinate with remote implementation, NOC, and project teams for connectivity testing and verification.
* Communicate installation status, issues, and dependencies proactively.
* Escalate site access, hardware, or environmental issues promptly to the Service Delivery Manager.



**Client Interaction \& SLA Accountability** 



* Act as the onsite technical representative, maintaining professional communication with the client during installation and testing activities.
* Ensure all activities are executed within defined SLAs, maintaining adherence to schedule, quality, and operational standards.
* Participate in service review meetings when required, presenting progress updates, risks, and completion reports.
* Document client feedback and ensure action plans are executed for continual service improvement.
* Uphold client satisfaction through transparent communication, professional conduct, and technical accuracy in all deliverables.



**Technical Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco, Fortinet, and Aruba network devices (Switches, Routers, Wireless APs).
* Knowledge of L2/L3 networking concepts such as VLANs, trunking, link aggregation, and routing fundamentals.
* Experience with firmware/IOS upgrades, device health checks, and configuration validation.
* Familiar with rack standards, structured cabling, grounding, and ESD compliance.
* Ability to interpret network diagrams, rack layouts, and cable schedules.
* Understanding of ITIL service operations and SLA\-driven delivery frameworks.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in on\-site network installation or service delivery engineering.
* Practical experience with Cisco IOS or equivalent enterprise network operating systems.
* Proven track record in executing rack installation, IOS upgrades, and post\-installation validation.
* Experience with ServiceNow or ITSM ticketing systems preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.



**Physical \& Site Requirements** 



* Ability to lift and install equipment (up to 10–15 kg).
* Comfortable working at installation heights up to 3 meters.
* Compliance with all site safety, ESD, and physical handling protocols.



**Key Deliverables** 



* Successful rack and stack of network devices per design and compliance standards.
* Verified device health and validated IOS upgrades.
* Comprehensive post\-installation documentation and photo evidence.
* 100% SLA adherence for onsite service activities.
* Client acknowledgment of service completion and satisfaction.

description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Performance Optimization (NPO) Engineer, you will monitor and analyze network performance, identify and diagnose root causes of issues, and implement optimization actions such as QoS adjustments, parameter tuning, and software upgrades to ensure continuous.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead and serve as the primary contact for specific technical domains and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), managing project deliverables independently.
* Engage with customers as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), offering technical guidance and insights.
* Optimize network performance through traffic, capacity, and neighbor management to enhance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and end\-user experience.
* Identify and recommend new feature rollouts and conduct carrier aggregation analysis for multi\-carrier networks.
* Perform analysis and optimization for benchmarking activities (e.g., Umlaut/P3, regulatory drive tests) and validate/optimize Network Performance Optimization (NPO) tools.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., CM, PM, FM, OMS) to resolve issues and manage customer interactions regarding Service Level Agreement (SLA) KPIs, regulatory compliance, and benchmarking reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You Have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in or related field with experience in Network Performance Optimization.
* Expertise in radio optimization for the latest SW/HW Release of Nokia 5G/4G and/or Samsung/Huawei 5G /4G Network.
* Experience in OEM\-specific tools and products, including Nokia SRAN BTS, NetAct, and/or Samsung LSMR, USM.
* Experience in at least two RATs (5G \& 4G) per OEM.
* End\-to\-end correlation across Radio, Access, IP, Transport, and Core domains.to improve Customer Experience, Service KPIs.
* Experience in spectrum refarming, 2G/3G sunset strategies, and post\-optimization activities. Proficiency in data visualization \& reporting tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Pivot Tables, Power BI).
* Experience in Radio Network Consolidation, ORAN, Cloud RAN, VRAN, Enterprise Networks, Private 5G, Massive MIMO, Network Slicing, MEC, and IoT Connectivity.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Good understanding of Managed Services Processes. Good experience in delivering managed services projects for a multi\-vendor environment.


**About Us**

 Key Job Responsibilities
   

  

 ID\-LB Cabling Infrastructure Tech at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

* Installation and testing of copper and Fiber Optic cabling.
* Creating/attaching labels and barcodes
* Understanding of test equipment (power meter / light source, OTDR, VFL, Fluke,


 network analyser, copper / fiber cabling test equipment)
   

  

* Basic build and troubleshooting of network devices.
* Managing inventory of related materials by checking and coordinating all materials to be delivered to site daily
* Adhering to defined escalation processes and standard operating procedures.

* Experience with a ticketing system
* Ability to travel within geographical work area is required. Occasional work in tight and/or narrow spaces, such as under raised floors

* Diploma/Graduation in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
* 1\-2 years of project management experience or operations planning experience
* 1\-2 years’ experience with physical network infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting
* 1\-2 years’ experience with network cabling (fiber optic \& copper)
* English language communication ability
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware and network cabling.
* Ability to work well with others in a team environment, displaying excellent time management skills and the ability to follow direction.
* Able to work at heights or use ladders for continued periods
* Have strong attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Substantial background in large scale datacentre network implementations and support.
* Knowledge of Copper and Fiber Optic testing methodologies.
* Ability to read basic layout drawings and floorplans.
* Industry standard certifications (CompTIA, CITY \& GUILDS Cabling cert or equivalent).
* Previous experience working in a Data Center environment (racking \& stacking gear, cable management).

**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 










 Your New Role
 

**:**


  
   





 The Network
 

 Automation
 

 Engineer
 

 role
 

 will
 

 be responsible for
 

 working with the Operations and Engineering Teams around the
 

 support
 

 and
 

 strategic
 



 improvement of the global
 



 network platform
 



 using
 

 programming and automation tools to streamline network operation
 

 . The individual will be evaluating processes regularly to ensure expected outcomes are achieved in the most efficient way along with identifying service improvements and
 

 document
 

 those improvements
 

 to h
 

 elp ensure standards and processes are followed.
 


  
 










 Your Role Accountabilities:
 


  
 




**OPERATIONS/PROJECT MANAGEMENT**

  
 



* Effectively
 

 develop and
 

 support all WBD
 

 network automation and scripting infrastructure and services
 

 24\*7 by responding to and resolving all
 

 requests and
 

 trouble tickets within the stipulated SLA time




  
 



* Clearly understand
 

 network automation needs across the global network team by partnering with team members to
 

 identify
 

 new automation capabilities and areas for process improvement




  
 



* Ability to prioritize work based on business criticalities
 

 and also
 

 be flexible to work on ad hoc tasks as assigned by the manager




  
 



* Fully understand and adhere to the team’s network standards and procedures both in technical and functional areas




  
 



* Maintain positive relationships with all user communities,
 

 peers
 

 and the management team




  
 



* Perform other duties as needed









 Qualifications \& Experiences:
 


  
 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science
 

 , Information Technology, Information Systems or similar


* 2 \- 5
 

 years of experience in
 

 network automation engineering
 

 in an enterprise network production environment


* Additional
 

 years of experience in network engineering, network operations or similar roles preferred


* Intermediate
 

 knowledge and experience using Terraform and or GitHub Actions to write
 

 IaC


* Modern scripting skills are
 

 required
 

 \- Python preferred


* Experience with
 

 IT automation tools
 

 required
 

 \-
 

 Ansible preferred


* Process oriented engineer with strong execution and follow\-through skills


* Able to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize self


* Strong and consistent customer service and communication skills


* Willingness to work a flexible schedule


* Strong team
 

 member with self\-motivation and desires to improve the infrastructure


* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills


* Must
 

 participate
 

 in an on\-call rotation
 

 for out of hours support


* Minimal travel
 

 anticipated
 

 for this position


* Must have the legal right to work in
 

 India



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Enterprise Technology \& Infrastructure
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Technical writers at Salesforce don’t just document products. They shape how customers understand, adopt, and succeed with them.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Writer, you will own and drive content for key product areas, designing scalable, high\-impact content across product and help experiences. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and other writers to ensure customers get the right information, in the right context, at the right time.
   

  

 We are evolving from traditional structured authoring (DITA/XML) to a modern docs\-as\-code approach (Git \+ Markdown), alongside AI\-assisted content workflows. This role is ideal for someone who can create scalable, high\-quality content, contribute to product decisions, and improve how content works across product and AI\-driven environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own and drive content for product areas or feature sets, from planning through delivery
* Design and deliver in\-product guidance, help content, and learning experiences (including Trailhead)
* Create modular, reusable, and structured content that scales across surfaces
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and UX to ensure content is accurate and ready at launch
* Influence product and UX decisions through a strong customer perspective
* Identify gaps in the customer journey and proactively design content solutions
* Use data and feedback to improve content effectiveness and customer outcomes
* Work within evolving content systems, including a transition from DITA/XML to docs\-as\-code (Git \+ Markdown)
* Use AI tools to accelerate content creation and design content optimized for AI\-driven experiences (search, assistants, and automation)
* Contribute to and help evolve team standards, processes, and content models


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5\-10 years of experience creating technical content for software products
* Proven ability to design content for end\-to\-end user journeys, not just individual topics
* Strong writing skills with the ability to make complex concepts clear and approachable
* Ability to quickly learn and explain complex technologies
* Experience working in structured authoring environments (DITA/XML preferred)
* Familiarity with source control systems (Git, Perforce, or similar)
* Openness to and interest in working with docs\-as\-code workflows (Git, Markdown)
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., LLMs) to improve content creation, editing, or scalability
* Ability to think in systems and create content that is reusable, structured, and adaptable across surfaces
* Experience working in Agile development environments
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence cross\-functional teams
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in docs\-as\-code environments using Git\-based workflows and Markdown
* Experience designing content for in\-product experiences or embedded help
* Familiarity with content systems that support personalization, dynamic delivery, or AI\-assisted experiences
* Ability to read and understand code, and create simple code samples where needed
* Experience with Salesforce products or CRM platforms
* Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML/CSS or modern UI frameworks


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Specialist Technical Writer
description:
We are looking for a Technical Documentation professional with strong expertise in DITA XML–based writing and structured content development. The role involves creating high\-quality, modular documentation, ensuring terminology and information architecture consistency, and maintaining accuracy across product releases. The ideal candidate will leverage AI responsibly to improve documentation efficiency and use Python to automate content validation and quality checks, while collaborating closely with engineering and tools teams to integrate automation into documentation workflows.
   

  

**Your Role**
 Key responsibilities in your new role
   

  

* Create, edit, and maintain high\-quality technical documentation using DITA XML (concepts, tasks, references, and maps).
* Develop modular, reusable, and structured content following DITA best practices.
* Enforce terminology consistency and information architecture standards.
* Perform substantive editing, copyediting, and proofreading of technical content.
* Maintain documentation accuracy across releases and product versions.
* Apply AI responsibly to improve efficiency while maintaining editorial accuracy and human oversight.
* Contribute to defining best practices for AI usage in technical documentation workflows.
* Use Python to automate documentation\-related tasks such as: Content validation, and quality checks.
* Collaborate with tools and engineering teams to integrate automation into documentation pipelines.


**Your Profile**
**Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed**
* 5\-8 years of experience as a technical writer
* Strong hands\-on experience with DITA XML and structured authoring
* Proven editorial expertise, including editing for clarity, grammar, style, and consistency
* Experience working with CMS and documentation tools
* Basic to intermediate Python skills for scripting and automation
* Working knowledge of AI tools applied to technical documentation or content workflows
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and quality.


**Contact:**
 umeshdatta.bamrule@infineon.com

title: Business Analyst – Life Insurance Domain
description:
**Location:** 
 PAN India (Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Delhi)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 8–10 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in Life Insurance applications and digital platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience working in Agile environments and possess a strong understanding of life insurance business processes and technology solutions.
   

  

 This role involves collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into effective technology solutions while aligning with operational and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Requirements Gathering \& Documentation**
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder discussions, and requirement\-gathering sessions.
* Analyze and document business requirements, user stories, use cases, and process flows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and functional specifications for system enhancements and product implementations.


 Process Analysis \& Improvement
   

  

* Analyze existing life insurance processes such as:
+ Policy Administration
+ Claims Processing
+ Underwriting
+ New Business

* Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities.
* Design future\-state business processes to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.


 Solution Design \& Collaboration
   

  

* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Collaborate with development teams to translate business requirements into functional solutions.
* Provide clarity on business processes and functional expectations during solution design.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Prepare test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate implemented solutions against business requirements and expected outcomes.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Manage and prioritize requirements across multiple stakeholders.
* Provide regular project updates, communicate business impacts, and manage expectations effectively.


**Required Skills \& Experience** 
  

  

* 7\+ years of overall experience as a Business Analyst.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in Life Insurance projects, preferably within US insurance environments.
* Strong experience in:
+ Requirement gathering
+ Stakeholder workshops
+ BRD/FRD documentation
+ User stories and process flows

* Good understanding of Life Insurance domains including:
+ Policy Administration
+ Claims
+ Underwriting
+ New Business

* Experience in process analysis, gap analysis, and process improvement initiatives.
* Ability to work closely with business and technical teams to deliver functional solutions.
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ UAT coordination
+ Test case preparation
+ Requirement validation

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills.
* Experience working in Agile and/or Waterfall delivery models.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on enterprise\-scale digital transformation or insurance modernization projects.
* Exposure to workflow automation and business process optimization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


 Work Model \& Shift Details
   

  

* Work Model: Hybrid / Remote
* Shift Timing: 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM
* Support may involve rotational or extended business\-hour coverage based on project requirements.


**Additional Requirements**
* Immediate to 15 days notice period preferred.
* Strong communication skills are mandatory.
* Candidates should demonstrate stable career progression and long\-term project ownership experience.
* Interview Process: 3 Rounds
* Expected Hiring Timeline: 10–15 Days


**Compensation**
* Compensation will be aligned with experience, current compensation, interview feedback, and internal benchmarking standards.


 Skills: automation opportunities,brd,process analysis,,identify gaps,,policy administration,requirement gathering,life insurance projects,stakeholder workshops,inefficiencies,underwriting,frd,uat coordination,test case preparation,claims processing,new business

**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The OT Cybersecurity Executive will be responsible for supporting and implementing cybersecurity measures to safeguard the organization's Operational Technology (OT) environments. This includes ensuring the security of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT assets that manage critical infrastructure. The role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, implementing best practices, and ensuring the security of OT systems against evolving cyber threats.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**OT Cybersecurity Executive**
**Operational Technology (OT) Security**
 Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.
   

  

 Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.
   

  

 Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.
   

  

 Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.
   

  

**Incident Response And Management**
 Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.
   

  

 Investigate and perform root\-cause analysis for OT\-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.
   

  

 Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.
   

  

**Collaboration With IT And OT Teams**
 Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross\-domain security breaches.
   

  

 Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.
   

  

 Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.
   

  

**Vulnerability Management**
 Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.
   

  

 Conduct risk\-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.
   

  

**Security Monitoring And Threat Intelligence**
 Continuously monitor OT systems and networks for any unusual activities, security breaches, or threats using appropriate tools and techniques.
   

  

 Leverage threat intelligence platforms to stay informed about the latest cyber threats targeting OT environments and recommend proactive defense measures.
   

  

 Perform regular updates to OT security monitoring systems and tools to detect emerging threats.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 OT Cybersecurity Manager / Head of Cybersecurity
   

  

 IT and Network Operations Teams
   

  

 Engineering \& Development Teams
   

  

 Human Resources (HR)
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 OT equipment and software vendors
   

  

 Third\-party cybersecurity service providers
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

 Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
   

  

**Certification**
 Relevant certifications such Global Industrial Cyber Security Practical experience with securing industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT assets and with OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, NERC CIP).
   

  

 Knowledge of OT network protocols and systems, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and others commonly used in industrial environments and with security tools and technologies used in OT environments (e.g., intrusion detection systems, firewalls, SIEM).

Managing a global workforce in today's rapidly changing and highly disrupted environment is increasingly complex. As a member of our Rewards and Transactions practice, you will be part of a team that supports clients in aligning their HR functions with organizational plans to build better Compensation and Benefits strategies, while prioritizing employee experience as a core consideration.


Joining us will provide you with cross\-functional, multi\-industry, and truly global work experience to advance your career in the right direction.


EY GDS is seeking qualified candidates to join our Rewards and Transactions practice team. Our team is actively involved in providing Total Rewards and HR consulting services to various world\-class organizations across the globe.




**Opportunity at EY:**

* Experience and learn world\-class consulting best practices while working on global client projects.

* Engage and learn Compensation and Benefits Design, Executive Compensation, Benchmarking, Rewards Compliance, Job Evaluation, Pay Equity, Job Family Architecture, and HR M\&A transactions.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements:**

* Preferred – Completed Bachelor's or Pursuing Master’s degree in HR or Mathematics
* Pursuing full\-time post\-graduation from other streams who are interested to join the field of HR consulting.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, with extensive knowledge of PowerPoint, Word, and Excel tools. Prior consulting or HR experience will be considered an advantage. Additionally, familiarity with the latest in\-demand skills such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), prompt engineering, data analytics, and digital transformation will enhance your candidacy.




**Key Job Specifications:**

**Willingness to Learn**: Demonstrate eagerness to acquire new skill sets, particularly in emerging areas like AI and data analytics.

**Integrity and Commitment**: Show high integrity and a commitment to working in a new, challenging environment.

**Proactivity**: Exhibit a proactive approach to tasks and responsibilities.

**Communication and Presentation Skills**: Strong abilities in both communication and presentation are essential.

**Cross\-Cultural Awareness**: Sensitivity to diverse cultures and practices.

**Multitasking Ability**: Capability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively under pressure.

**What Working at EY Offers:**


At EY, we are committed to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do is as diverse as they are. You will engage in inspiring and meaningful projects, with a focus on education and coaching alongside practical experience to support your personal development. We value our employees and empower you to take control of your growth with an individual progression plan. You will quickly assume a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Additionally, we offer:

* Support, coaching, and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you best.

Bangalore Hub serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.

We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented HR IT Analyst to join our team and play a key role in transforming our processes into digital solutions. You will work closely with the HR, PEX teams at our global locations to understand their needs and challenges and then collaborate with the technology teams within HR IT and broader Unilever IT to design and implement innovative digital solutions that streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee experience.

*Necessary Experience \& Qualifications*

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
